BNB.summary: Mildly supportive for the long: the Oct 19 quarterly burn removed about 1.65M BNB, and treasury firm BNB Standard (515K+ BNB) rings the Nasdaq bell Oct 26. BNB has no vesting unlocks.

TRX.summary: Tron Inc., a large TRX treasury holder, became a Super Representative; a minor positive for the long. TRX has no vesting unlocks.

news.title: Tron Inc. elected a TRON Super Representative, moving into block production and governance revenue

SYRUP.summary: SYRUP fell about 24% in a week with the DeFi downturn even as buybacks doubled (1.37M SYRUP bought with September revenue). Fully unlocked, so no supply overhang for the long.

APT.summary: Works against the short: investor/contributor vesting ended in October, cutting monthly unlocks about 60%, and APT bounced about 6% on that repricing. Next unlock is a Community tranche on Nov 11 (amount not disclosed).

news.title: APT rises about 6% as markets reprice the end of investor vesting
Aptos ships an opt-in encrypted mempool on mainnet to curb front-running
Block-STM v2 parallel execution enabled by default on Aptos mainnet

unlock.note: Community allocation per Tokenomist (amount paywalled). The four-year investor/core-contributor schedule ended Oct 12.

LTC.summary: Only small Canary spot ETF inflows. LTC is proof-of-work with no unlocks, so nothing changes the short thesis.

news.title: Canary Litecoin ETF (LTCC) takes about $581K in inflows after a week of flat flows

FET.summary: No fresh catalyst for the long; AGIX-to-FET conversions are still paused after the Sep 20 bridge exploit. Tokenomist lists an AGIX-migration pool release on Oct 28 with no amount, but another source shows all unlocks complete (low confidence).

news.title: Commentary notes FET lagging the rally while AGIX-to-FET conversions stay paused after the bridge exploit

unlock.note: AGIX migration pool per Tokenomist; app.tokenomics.com shows all unlocks complete. This is a migration release, not team/investor vesting, and its supply impact is uncertain while conversions are paused. Low confidence.

ETC.summary: No price-moving ETC news this week. Proof-of-work with no unlocks; the Sep 28 block-reward cut already happened, so the short trades on structure alone.

SUPER.summary: No SUPER-specific news this week. Vesting completed in Jan 2024, so there is no unlock overhang; the short trades on structure alone.

JTO.summary: No JTO-specific news since the Oct 15 selloff. No cliff unlock, but linear weekly vesting to investors and contributors adds steady supply, which suits the short.

news.title: JTO drops about 6% in a broad altcoin selloff tied to an Asian equity rout

ATOM.summary: No verifiable price-moving ATOM news this week. ATOM is inflationary with no vesting cliffs.

SEI.summary: Supportive for the long: the REX-Osprey staked SEI ETF has an Oct 23 target effective date (trading may come later). Monthly Ecosystem Reserve unlock on Nov 15; the Oct 15 tranche (~55.6M SEI) was absorbed without a sell-off.

news.title: Monthly ecosystem unlock of about 55.6M SEI absorbed without a sell-off

Sei cumulative DEX volume nears $16B, though activity is concentrated on one venue

unlock.note: Monthly Ecosystem Reserve release per Tokenomist (amount paywalled; Oct tranche was ~55.6M SEI).

OP.summary: Risk for the short: the OP buyback program has bought over 9.4M OP and Unichain moves to OP Enterprise on Oct 29. A small Seed Fund unlock follows on Dec 1.

news.title: Optimism's buyback program passes 9.4M OP purchased

WLD.summary: Supports the long: WLD rallied on World ID for banks, though no paying bank customer is named yet. Supply keeps unlocking continuously at about 2.9M WLD/day with no single cliff.

World presents World ID for banking at Money20/20; no named bank customer yet

INJ.summary: Risk for the short: a staked INJ ETF is pending, a new native USDC route went live and the monthly buyback-and-burn continues (7.2M+ INJ burned). INJ is fully unlocked.
